news.body:
## This morning, and the four days after it
- Both halves of Wednesday are closed.
You wrote to Fitria yesterday afternoon confirming 10am in person, and the originals are in your hand. Nothing is left to arrange before the room.
- The apostille is dated Saturday and still reads To-do.
Campus France's October correction asked for the original bachelor certificate in colour and the transcript, which are the same papers the courier has just delivered. Fitria is the one person who can say precisely what the consulate wants apostilled and attested - ask her in the room this morning rather than working it out on Thursday.

## Money
- Does the 5 November instalment need the EUR account?
The EUR 53,000 instalment sits on 5 November and the task for opening the account sits on 30 November, after it. If SBI disburses straight to INSEAD the order is harmless; if any of it has to pass through an account of yours, that date is in the wrong place.
